correctness.rationale: The basis-column equivalence is exact for every edge form. The two-state weighted transfer enumerates all adjacent-dependent sequences in a fixed d-space; Cayley–Hamilton gives the recurrence with stated initial conditions. The known subspace-lattice Möbius values then isolate full-span sequences, whose free GL_r action gives each r-subspace once. The strictly ordered positive transfer roots give analytic quasi-powers and a characteristic-function CLT; the explicit mean and positive variance follow by twice differentiating the quadratic characteristic equation. The included independent RREF enumerator passed 86 (q,n,r) cases over q=2,3,4,5 and rational-series tests over q=2,3,4,5,7. q=2 matrix-space assertions are not conflated with odd-prime group assertions.

value.rationale: The complete rank–support statistic is naturally defined for central-containing abelian subgroups of path graphical class-two p-groups and in the associated isotropic Grassmannians. Unlike an isolated coefficient, the bivariate transfer gives all finite path lengths and ranks, while the explicit density and variance quantify a nontrivial asymptotic structural law. The binary field has exactly half-density for every fixed positive rank, and all positive-rank laws have nonzero Gaussian fluctuations. The result addresses the explicit need for efficient recursive methods noted in Qiao 2024, without claiming that prior group/isotropy dictionary or unweighted count is new.
